top_choice_rationale: P002 rewards a complete, independently reproduced chain from prediction to observation: Kane and Mele's Z2 time-reversal-invariant topological insulator and helical edge, and Molenkamp's measured edge conduction in HgTe wells, later confirmed by transport and ARPES in several materials and now routinely exploited in first-principles materials prediction. It is a new state of matter distinct from the 2016 broken-time-reversal topology prize, provided the citation stays narrow to the 2D quantum spin Hall state. The Bernevig-Hughes-Zhang and 3D attribution gap is real but bounded by the wording. P001 (Katori and Ye) is a close second with cleaner credit and strong maturity, but it is an instrument invention more than a discovery; any award is preferable to none.
recusal_note: none apparent from profile; scientific bias declared as an electronic-structure theorist who would welcome recognition of topological-materials prediction, with no personal tie to Kane, Mele, Molenkamp, Katori or Ye
